overview.title: Program Overview
overview.desc: The Global Career Starter Program is a program from TalenCo that supports your first step toward a global career through language learning, real projects, and cultural experience.

cards.title: English Class
cards.desc: Improve your English skills for international work. This class is associated with LBI FIB UI.

cards.title: BIPA Class
cards.desc: Learn Indonesian language and cultural phrases. This class is associated with LBI FIB UI.

cards.title: Digital Marketing Class
cards.desc: Gain practical skills for digital marketing. This class is associated with Herdento Global Solution.

cards.title: Career Preparation
cards.desc: Job hunting tips, interview skills, and soft skills. This class is associated with Herdento Global Solution.

cards.title: Indonesian Culture Class
cards.desc: Understand customs, traditions, and society. This class is associated with LBI FIB UI.

cards.title: Weekend Trip
cards.desc: Experiential trip to Payung Islands on the weekend (add-ons).

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.desc: Choose between online classes or the full on-site experience in Indonesia. Flights and local transport are not included in either package.
pricing.note: Prices shown in JPY for reference. Actual payment is processed in IDR (Indonesian Rupiah). We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, JCB, and local Indonesian payment methods.

items.q: How much is the program fee?
What is the refund policy if I cancel?
items.a: Cancellation must be made at least 30 days before the program. Refunds after that date are not available.
Accommodation and airport transportation is included. Flights and local transport are not included.
Weekend trips are add-ons. See program guidelines for details.
Participants must have a valid passport. Visa will be processed by TalenCo.
